finding: The custom-ledger mechanisms that DF-ASR-2026-C002 replaces are still the validation and evidence of record for the control that replaces them. The resilience model still relies on anchoring to detect tampering.
evidence: C002 defers hash chaining, witness cosignatures and RFC 3161 timestamps. Yet CTL-ASR-002 lists evidence EVT-024 (witness cosignatures) and EVT-025 (RFC 3161 token), plus validation VAL-018 ('Recomputes hash chain ... compares checkpoints with externally anchored digests'). BR-ASR-006 also cites VAL-018. VAL-002 requires a 'hash-chain entry'; VAL-012 'verifies hash chain continuity'. In validation/assurance-system-resilience.md, R1, R4 and R16 detect tampering via 'anchor mismatch (VAL-018)' and 'External anchoring + daily chain verification'.
recommended_fix: Re-point CTL-ASR-002 and BR-ASR-006 to retention-lock configuration verification (VAL-009 with EVT-029) plus delete-denial tests, and mark VAL-018/EVT-024/EVT-025 deferred. Rewrite VAL-002/VAL-012 and resilience rows R1/R4/R16 to say how tampering is detected without anchoring, and state the residual risk that the owner is the cloud administrator.

finding: Questions marked resolved/answered are presented elsewhere as open owner decisions that block work.
evidence: OQ-806 is classification resolved-owner-decision, blocking_tier none, status answered ('Answered by decision 13'). But ODP-06 calls it an unresolved conflict between owner records and lists OQ-806 under 'Blocks', and WI-VIGILA-01 lists OQ-806 as a blocker. OQ-760 is resolved/answered ('Answered by decision 12'), while ODP-07 lists it as blocked, BR-APP-001 lists it as an external dependency, and WI-STRATA-04/WI-STRATA-01 list it as a blocker. OQ-800 is resolved, but ODP-02 lists it under 'Blocks'.
recommended_fix: Reopen OQ-806 and OQ-760 (proposed_status open, blocking_tier implementation or requirements-finalization), or remove them from ODP and backlog blockers. Also recount the executive-findings question statistics.

finding: The operating model mitigates owner self-approval using a superseded decision. Its mitigation also contradicts the baseline exception rule.
evidence: governance/operating-model.md line 68: 'Approver equals implementer for owner-authored work and owner-requested exceptions. Mitigation: these are recorded as compensating-control exceptions in a review queue (DF-ASR-2026-7B20, proposed).' But decision-register.csv marks 7B20 superseded (by 0D04). BR-GOV-004 says 'material exceptions are never self-approved; if the required independent approver is unavailable, the action is blocked or redesigned'. With one human, every material owner exception is blocked under the baseline but allowed under the operating model.
recommended_fix: Remove the 7B20 citation. Decide explicitly, as an owner item in the ODP, how owner-originated material exceptions are handled until ODP-02 provides a reviewer, and make BR-GOV-004 and the operating model say the same thing.

finding: The catalog commits to an annual external penetration test. The baseline obtains one only when it is obligated or justified.
evidence: CTL-VUL-002 objective: 'Independent testers test in-scope systems at least annually and after significant change'. CTL-VUL-002 is P1; VAL-027 frequency is 'annual and on major change'. BR-VAL-003 (P4): 'penetration tests are obtained when a legal, contractual, regulatory or customer obligation is confirmed, or when residual risk justifies'. CST source: 'SOC 2 does not itself prescribe a universal annual penetration test'. CTL-VUL-002 evidence is EVT-016 (incident record), which cannot evidence a penetration test.
recommended_fix: Align CTL-VUL-002 objective, phase and VAL-027 frequency with BR-VAL-003 (trigger-based), or record an explicit decision for annual testing. Add an evidence type for the external engagement report reference (restricted).

finding: Policy links are assigned per area by bulk rule, not per obligation. For 53 of 107 BR rows, the BR's policy_ids share no policy (or parent/child) with the policies of the BR's own controls.
evidence: Every FIN row cites POL-12.02 (Accounting integrity), including BR-FIN-006 funds-movement authority (controls use POL-12.01), BR-FIN-008 reconciliation (POL-12.03), BR-FIN-019 fraud and BR-FIN-022 sanctions (POL-12.04), and BR-FIN-004 idempotency (POL-12.06 exists). Every GOV/ASR/VAL row cites POL-01.04: BR-GOV-004 exceptions (control uses POL-01.05), BR-GOV-007 delegation (POL-01.06), BR-GOV-008 risk (POL-01.02). Every AI row cites POL-11.02: BR-AI-004 prompt injection (POL-11.04). Every APP row cites POL-06.01: BR-APP-006 tenant isolation (POL-05.05), BR-APP-010 crypto (POL-05.02), BR-APP-012 secrets (POL-04.05). BR-CUS-003 onboarding cites POL-13.05 (POL-13.01 exists). BR-HR-002 conflicts of interest cites POL-03 (POL-02.01 exists). The validator only checks that the IDs exist.
recommended_fix: Set each BR's policy_ids to the policy sections its controls implement. Add a validator rule: a BR's policies must intersect (allowing parent/child) the policies of its controls.

finding: Many validation_ids name procedures that cannot validate the requirement. The validator passes because only existence is checked.
evidence: BR-APP-011 (application timeouts/backpressure) -> VAL-008 'Fault injection on assurance pipeline'. BR-APP-012 secrets, BR-VUL-002 SAST/secret detection and BR-VUL-003 DAST -> VAL-031 'Seeded known-fail control (sentinel)'. BR-APP-004 memory safety -> VAL-003 'Property-based tests of financial and authorization invariants'. BR-HR-001 training -> VAL-013 access-control testing. BR-HR-002 conflicts/whistleblowing and BR-GOV-016 deficiencies -> VAL-004 'Negative security tests for prohibited agent actions'. BR-GOV-009 obligation register, BR-GOV-012 regulatory monitoring and BR-VUL-013 VDP -> VAL-010 'Synthetic transactions and canary controls'. BR-VEN-001 vendor register -> VAL-009 configuration verification. BR-CUS-003 onboarding/termination -> VAL-014 cross-tenant isolation. BR-GOV-015 economics -> VAL-001 'Unit tests of control predicates'. The BR validation_method text (e.g. 'Resource-exhaustion and dependency-failure tests') describes procedures that do not exist in the register.
recommended_fix: Add the missing procedures (application load/resource-exhaustion, SAST/DAST harness validation, browser adversarial tests, crypto rotation and invalid-signature tests, register-completeness review) and re-map. Consider a validator check that a BR's validation_ids overlap its controls' validation_ids.

finding: The evidence_type_ids cannot carry the evidence each row's own evidence_obligation requires.
evidence: BR-APP-001 obligation 'DB role/privilege snapshot per deployment' -> only EVT-003/EVT-004 (CI result, test result); no DB privilege evidence type exists. BR-APP-008 'Egress policy snapshot' and BR-APP-010 'KMS and TLS configuration snapshot' -> EVT-008 (cloud audit log batch), not a configuration snapshot (EVT-028/EVT-029 are closer). BR-VEN-001 vendor register and BR-DAT-002 privacy inventory -> EVT-008 cloud audit logs. BR-GOV-008 risk register, BR-GOV-009 obligation register and BR-GOV-015 economics -> EVT-003 'CI check result'. BR-VAL-003 'Engagement letters and reports' and BR-GOV-013 succession 'Exercise record' -> EVT-016 'Incident record'. BR-GOV-016 deficiencies -> EVT-011 'Vulnerability scan result'. CTL-VUL-002 pen test and CTL-VUL-003 VDP -> EVT-016.
recommended_fix: Add evidence types for DB privilege snapshots, configuration snapshots, register versions, exercise records and external engagement references, then re-map. Require each evidence_obligation to be satisfiable by the listed types.

finding: 32 of 107 baseline requirements have no work item in roadmap/backlog.csv. 14 of them are P1 'shared foundations', including most security-by-construction topics.
evidence: No requirements_addressed entry covers: BR-APP-003 (JS boundary), BR-APP-007 (input schemas), BR-APP-008 (outbound), BR-APP-009 (CSRF/CORS), BR-APP-010 (crypto), BR-APP-011 (resource limits), BR-SDL-003 (AI change provenance), BR-SDL-004 (threat modelling), BR-AI-002 (no self-approval), BR-AI-004 (prompt injection; ODP-08 asks the owner to accept this risk), BR-AI-007 (model evaluation), BR-VAL-002, BR-GOV-006, BR-GOV-016, BR-ASR-003 (population reconciliation, one of C002's three replacement mechanisms), BR-ASR-010 (machinery validation), BR-IAM-002 (ODP-03 'compensating alerts now'), and BR-FIN-007/011/013/014/015/017/018/019. BR-APP-007..011 also have empty echelon_systems.
recommended_fix: Add work items (with owning repository) for each uncovered BR, or record in the baseline why none is needed. Add a validator rule that every non-deferred BR is addressed by at least one work item.

finding: Three phase systems disagree: BR roadmap_phase, backlog phase and catalog roadmap_phase. 22 BRs are scheduled earlier than every work item that implements them, and about 40 BRs disagree with their controls' phases in both directions.
evidence: BR-FIN-020 P0 (ODP-05 'approve') but WI-UNB-01 P2 and WI-EXT-03 P4. BR-ASR-008 and BR-LOG-001 P1 but WI-VIGILA-01/02/03 and WI-AEGIS-01 P3. BR-IAM-004 P1 vs WI-ORG-01 P3. BR-AI-003/BR-AI-006 P1 vs WI-ORG-03/WI-ORG-02 P3. BR-VUL-001 P1 vs WI-REGISTRY-01 P3. BR-APP-005/006 P1 vs WI-UNB-03/WI-STRATA-02 P2. BR-GOV-015 P0 vs WI-SCALE-01 P5. Every BR-FIN-001..018 is P2 while CTL-FIN-001..008/010/011/015..017 are P1. BR-ASR-003 P2 vs CTL-ASR-003 P3. BR-IR-001 P3 vs CTL-IR-001 P0. controls-by-phase.md labels P1 'Required before production', while the backlog defines P1 as 'shared foundations' and P3 as 'operational readiness'. The validator checks only WI-to-WI ordering.
recommended_fix: Define one phase semantics. Derive BR phase as the earliest phase of its controls, or require them to agree, and require at least one WI no later than the BR phase. Add these as validator rules.

finding: Separation of evidence privileges, including the rule that agents cannot overwrite evidence, is scheduled for P3. Agents receive execution authority and evidence is emitted from P1.
evidence: BR-ASR-005 ('applications and agents cannot overwrite or delete authoritative evidence') is P3, and BR-ASR-006 managed immutable storage is P3 (WI-ARCA-01 P3). BR-ASR-001 evidence emission is P1. BR-AI-001 (A2 execution) is P1. CTL-AI-005 'Agents cannot alter evidence' is P1. All P1-P2 Unbound reference evidence is therefore produced with no store-level immutability and no privilege separation.
recommended_fix: Move the agent no-overwrite and privilege-separation part of BR-ASR-005 to P1, matching CTL-AI-005, or state in BR-ASR-001 that P1-P2 evidence is non-authoritative until the P3 store exists.

finding: Four systems carry status 'verified-implemented' on source inspection alone, with tests not executed. That is status inflation contrary to AGENTS.md rule 3. 21 financial BRs rely on SYS-SUMMA.
evidence: SYS-SUMMA test_evidence: '~94 test files, ~670 test cases (source count, not executed)', status verified-implemented. SYS-LIMEN, SYS-ORDO and SYS-AEGIS are the same ('source count, not executed'), status verified-implemented. FIN-BC source: 'Use Summa ledger patterns only after capability verification'. The executive findings say tests were executed for only 5 systems.
recommended_fix: Downgrade the status to 'source-inspected' or 'claimed-implemented' until tests are executed. Add a validator rule: verified-implemented requires verification_basis = tests-executed.

finding: The auditor non-reliance penalty and the maintenance multiplier apply only to Echelon-built alternatives. A commercial compliance platform (A2) also produces system-generated evidence, so the headline conclusion is biased in A2's favour.
evidence: The condition=nonreliance lines exist only for A5 (ACT-048), A6 (ACT-061) and A7 (ACT-074). A2 has none (ACT-013..019) and no maintenance line, so the A2 and A3 totals are identical in S0, S2, S4 and S5 ($1,118k/$1,113k at N=1). README/executive findings: 'If the auditor will not rely on system-generated evidence, targeted automation never breaks even against [A2]'. This rests on an unlabelled assumption that auditors rely on vendor-platform evidence but not on Echelon evidence.
recommended_fix: Add a non-reliance line (hypothetical class) for A2's automated evidence, and a maintenance/integration-upkeep line for A2. Re-run the econ command and restate the S4/S5 conclusions, or label the asymmetry as an explicit assumption in the README and C005.

finding: The README omits that the recommended immediate option, A4, costs more than A3 (outsourced management) until 8 products in the base case and 18 in S5. The break-even figures it quotes cover A5, A6 and A7 only.
evidence: generated/model.md S0 break-even: 'A4-mvp-echelon | A3-outsourced-management | 8'. S5: 'A4-mvp-echelon | A3-outsourced-management | 18'. At N=1 the S0 midpoints are A4 $1,140k vs A3 $1,113k. The README says 'A4 minimum viable is unaffected' by non-reliance but gives no A4 break-even.
recommended_fix: Report the A4 break-even in the README and executive findings, and justify the choice of A4 over A3 on non-cost grounds (reuse, prevention) as an explicit judgment.

finding: C001 makes the baseline authoritative, yet five catalog controls trace to no baseline requirement. That leaves endpoint security, controlled data export, public administrative endpoints and external attack-surface scanning outside it.
evidence: No BR control_ids include CTL-END-001 (managed endpoints, MDM), CTL-DAT-004 (controlled data export), CTL-NET-002 (no public admin endpoints; 'external attack-surface scan'), CTL-VEN-005 or CTL-GOV-013. CST-011 ('safe non-destructive checks' of the external attack surface) was consolidated into BR-VUL-001, which only inventories ('detective-only', 'Inventory reconciliation against cloud and DNS'). The validator accepts controls supported by regulatory requirements alone.
recommended_fix: Add BR rows, or extend existing ones, for endpoint security, data export, admin-endpoint exposure and the external attack-surface scan (restoring CST-011's testing obligation), or record why each sits outside the internal baseline.

finding: C001 says nine requirement documents were consolidated, including reconciliation. No source-dispositions row cites reconciliation-and-roadmap.md, so its 18 challenge-finding obligations have no disposition.
evidence: The distinct source_document values in source-dispositions.csv are 8 files; reconciliation-and-roadmap.md and challenge-review.md are absent. Undispositioned REC obligations include item 16 ('no assumption that hosted payments eliminate PCI scope'; no BR covers card/PCI scope, OQ-304), item 18 (framework-neutral evidence mapping), item 8 (L5 limited to bounded reversible remediation) and item 5 (prefer deterministic payment workers). BR justifications nonetheless cite 'reconciliation finding 2/5/9'. ODP-01 tells the owner '189 original IDs ... No requirement is removed'.
recommended_fix: Assign IDs (e.g. REC-01..18) and disposition each to a BR, or record that they are rationale only. Correct C001 and ODP-01 to say which documents were dispositioned.

finding: Scope reductions are labelled 'consolidate' instead of 'simplify', which inflates the claim 'nothing removed' (137 consolidate, 0 remove). Mutation and bypass validation was narrowed from every requirement to money, tenant and release controls.
evidence: The rationale for PEC-026, VAL-BC-004, VAL-BC-012 and CST-015 reads 'Mutation, machinery validation and security-tool validation are one practice; scope narrowed by risk', with disposition consolidate. BR-ASR-010: 'applied in full to controls protecting money, tenant data and release, sampled elsewhere'. The SBC source requires, for each requirement, that 'Tests must fail when the enforcement mechanism is deliberately disabled'. That paragraph has no ID and is not dispositioned. Executive findings: 'consolidate all 189 original owner requirements, with nothing removed'.
recommended_fix: Re-label these as simplify, with the narrowing stated. Disposition the SBC validation-and-claims paragraph. Restate the disposition counts in executive findings, ODP-01 and C001.

finding: Parts of the contribution and investment obligations are lost or untraced in consolidation.
evidence: FIN-BC-016 requires distinguishing 'pledge, receipt, acceptance, return and settlement'. BR-FIN-013 keeps 'completion, acceptance, availability and acknowledgement' only; returned/refunded contributions and pledges are dropped. FIN-BC-015 ('Fee and investment allocation correctness') is dispositioned only to BR-FIN-012; BR-FIN-023 (investment valuation) has empty source_refs, so the split is invisible to the bidirectional check.
recommended_fix: Add contribution return/refund and pledge handling to BR-FIN-013 (or record the exclusion). Add FIN-BC-015 to BR-FIN-023 source_refs and to the FIN-BC-015 disposition row.

finding: Durable, idempotent processing is scoped to financial products only. Non-financial queues and webhooks, evidence collectors and security jobs have no durability or idempotency requirement beyond BR-APP-007 input validation.
evidence: BR-FIN-004 applicability = financial-products, owner Finance/controls owner. SBC-009 is financial-specific; the mission topic is 'durable idempotent processing'. Evidence-pipeline duplicate and late events are covered only by VAL-008 fault injection, with no BR obligation.
recommended_fix: Add an all-products durable-acceptance and idempotent-handler requirement (or broaden BR-FIN-004 applicability) covering webhooks, jobs and evidence collectors.

finding: The status ladder that BR-ASR-002 mandates is not the ladder the catalog, schema and validator use. Independence levels cannot be recorded or checked.
evidence: BR-ASR-002: 'distinguishes Designed, Implemented, internally tested, technically independently verified, organizationally independently assessed and externally attested ... each status records its independence level'. controls/README.md and Traceability.fs statusRank use Proposed, Designed, Specified, Implemented, Operating, Tested, AuditorReviewed (with Deficient/Remediating unranked). Neither has 'technically independently verified' or an independence field. Dispositions cite 'unified in validation/assurance-status-model', and no such file exists.
recommended_fix: Create the status model, or align BR-ASR-002 to the catalog vocabulary plus an independence_level column. Make the validator enforce it, and fix the dangling reference.

finding: Two authoritative sources for policy are proposed. Generating policy-inventory.csv from a new F# model adds a system that duplicates a register already declared authoritative.
evidence: AGENTS.md rule 8: 'CSV registers under ... policies/ are the source of truth'. BR-GOV-001: 'Policies are defined once in a versioned F# model'. WI-ASR-06 deliverable: 'generator for policies/policy-inventory.csv; Inventory regenerated byte-identical from model'. BR-GOV-002 says generation is used only 'where generation removes a duplicated source'. A byte-identical regeneration of the existing CSV removes no duplicate.
recommended_fix: Choose one source of truth. Either keep the CSV authoritative and limit the F# model to executable decisions, or amend AGENTS.md and C001 to make the model authoritative and retire hand-editing of the CSV.

finding: Controls and the resilience model assume a second person exists. The decision package states that the owner holds all privileged roles alone.
evidence: CTL-IAM-006: 'use triggers alert to two people'. CTL-IAM-005: 'approval by non-requester'. Resilience R1: 'just-in-time elevation with second-person approval'. R3: 'protected pipeline definitions with second-person review'. ODP-03: 'The owner holds cloud root, organization owner, verifier keys and evidence-store administration'. These designs cannot operate until ODP-02/03/04 are decided, but they are not marked dependent on them.
recommended_fix: Mark these mechanisms as dependent on ODP-03/ODP-04 (external_dependencies OQ-804/OQ-607), and state the one-person interim design (e.g. alert to an external delegate) in the control rows.

finding: ODP-03 recommends 'compensating alerts now', but the requirement that delivers them is P3 and has no work item.
evidence: ODP-03 recommendation: 'Accept with compensating alerts now'. BR-IAM-002 (independent alerting, break-glass) has roadmap_phase P3, and no backlog row lists BR-IAM-002 in requirements_addressed.
recommended_fix: Add a P0/P1 work item for independent privileged-access alerting, or change the ODP-03 recommendation to the phase actually planned.

finding: The executive findings cite a validation report that does not exist as evidence that review passes were performed.
evidence: executive-findings.md section 4: 'They are a structured self-review, not independent assurance (`findings/validation-report.md`)'. README.md line 52 links the same file. findings/ contains no validation-report.md. REC deliverables also list a 'validation report and change log'.
recommended_fix: Produce the validation report (including this review's dispositions), or remove the citation.

finding: The executive findings overstate what the validator enforces.
evidence: Executive findings: the validator 'fails on orphaned requirements, ... missing owners, validation or evidence'. Traceability.fs requiredBaselineColumns checks free-text validation_method and evidence_obligation but not validation_ids, evidence_type_ids, risk_ids or source_refs. No rule fails a BR that has no source, no work item and no inbound reference; 13 BRs have empty source_refs, e.g. BR-LOG-001, BR-FIN-019..023. Semantic fit of links (findings R1-005..007) is not checked.
recommended_fix: Either add validation_ids and evidence_type_ids to the required columns and define and enforce 'orphaned requirement', or narrow the claim in the executive findings and C001.

finding: The roadmap quotes stale per-phase control counts.
evidence: implementation-roadmap.md: 'P0 13, P1 67, P2 13, P3 10, P4 1 controls' (104 total). The catalog and controls-by-phase.md have P0 11, P1 86, P2 13, P3 10, P4 1 (121).
recommended_fix: Regenerate or remove the counts from the prose.

finding: A legal characterization is stated as fact while the questions it depends on remain open with counsel.
evidence: Executive findings: 'Under FinCEN's definition, money transmission begins with acceptance of funds, which the design avoids.' OQ-216 and OQ-205 are dependent-legal, OQ-206 dependent-customer, all production-launch, open. TNT-02 constraint: 'no legal characterization assumed'.
recommended_fix: Rephrase as a design intent with evidence class 'assumption' pending counsel (CQ-1/CQ-3).

finding: Several BRs lack the parameters needed to implement or test them. Their acceptance criteria are undefined.
evidence: BR-AI-008: 'disclosed where appropriate' (no criteria for 'material'). BR-BCR-001: 'exercised against defined objectives', but no RTO/RPO is defined in any baseline row. BR-VUL-009: 'remediated with SLAs', with no SLA values in the baseline or validation registers. BR-VUL-007: 'production-equivalent' undefined. BR-GOV-011: review 'triggered by material change and risk' with no thresholds. BR-APP-011: 'explicit timeouts ... rate limits' with no ownership of the limit values and no system.
recommended_fix: Add parameter references (an RTO/RPO register entry, a severity-SLA table, materiality criteria for AI disclosure and review triggers), or record each as an open question blocking implementation.

finding: Deferred ledger machinery remains as live register entries and designs, which adds maintenance surface and conflicts with TNT-13. A ledger-level hash chain persists in a financial control.
evidence: EVT-024, EVT-025 and VAL-018 remain active register rows. Resilience R16 'Anchoring/witness lapse' is a live threat row. architecture/evidence-architecture.md keeps the full anchoring design (marked 'design history'). CTL-FIN-001 mechanism includes 'hash-chained batches', which no BR-FIN row requires.
recommended_fix: Mark deferred register rows with a status (e.g. deferred) excluded from active traceability. Remove 'hash-chained batches' from CTL-FIN-001 or justify it in a BR.

finding: Proposed (unaccepted) decisions are already applied to the authoritative catalog and baseline, contrary to the AGENTS.md authority rule ('Do not treat your own proposed decisions as authorized').
evidence: The CTL-ASR-002 title already reads 'Managed immutable evidence storage (custom ledger and anchor...'. BR-ASR-006 disposition is replace, and BR-APP-002 is strengthen. C002 and C003 have status proposed, decided_by 'pending owner'. ODP-01 asks the owner to accept them.
recommended_fix: Mark the affected rows as pending decision (e.g. a decision_status column), or keep the pre-decision text until ODP-01 is accepted.
